steps.text: NA-0776 (RULING_016): THE SITE SET IS DEFINED BY ROLE, NOT BY ELEMENT TYPE -- the list-column heading of EACH screen (Chats, Contacts, Settings) plus the six detail-pane h2s. The Settings list-column heading is a <header>, not an h2, which is exactly how the earlier eight-h2 census missed it and why only the operator's flight caught it.

return (function(){var n=window.__na,k=Object.keys(n),TOL=0.5;var f=[];if(k.length!==9)f.push('SITES='+k.length+' expected 9');var tops=k.map(function(x){return n[x].h2.t;});var hs=k.map(function(x){return n[x].row.h;});function spread(a){return Math.max.apply(null,a)-Math.min.apply(null,a);}if(spread(tops)>TOL)f.push('A1 heading tops spread='+spread(tops).toFixed(2)+' '+JSON.stringify(k.map(function(x){return x+'='+n[x].h2.t.toFixed(1);})));if(spread(hs)>TOL)f.push('A2 row heights spread='+spread(hs).toFixed(2));var rails=k.map(function(x){return n[x].rail.c;});if(spread(rails)>TOL)f.push('rails disagree');k.forEach(function(x){var d=Math.abs(n[x].h2.c-n[x].rail.c);if(d>TOL)f.push('A3 '+x+' centre-vs-rail='+d.toFixed(2));});var fs=k.map(function(x){return n[x].h2.fs;}),fw=k.map(function(x){return n[x].h2.fw;});var hh=k.map(function(x){return n[x].h2.h;});function uniq(a){return a.filter(function(v,i){return a.indexOf(v)===i;});}if(uniq(fs).length!==1)f.push('A4 font-size differs '+JSON.stringify(k.map(function(x){return x+'='+n[x].h2.fs;})));if(uniq(fw).length!==1)f.push('A4 font-weight differs '+JSON.stringify(k.map(function(x){return x+'='+n[x].h2.fw;})));if(spread(hh)>TOL)f.push('A4 heading box heights spread='+spread(hh).toFixed(2));return f.length?f.join(' | '):'OK';})();
